name: 80. Codex functions namespace unwrap and reserved namespace names on Mantle (#7048 / PR #7084)
description: Regression coverage for PR #7084 (follows #7082 and #7039). Codex CLI >= 0.147 wraps its default function and custom tools in a namespace literally named `functions` on every request (openai/codex#37022). Bedrock Mantle reserves that name and rejects the whole request with "Invalid Value: 'tools.namespace'. User-defined namespace 'functions' collides with an existing tool namespace." Core now unwraps that namespace to top-level tools, unprefixed, for every provider before dispatch: Codex treats the bare name and the explicit `functions` namespace as the same tool, so nothing needs mapping back, and on flattening wires the members must not acquire a `functions__` prefix. The same PR moved the reserved-namespace list (`web`, `image_gen`, `browser`, `python` on bedrock and bedrock_mantle) behind the datasheet row `reserved_tool_namespaces`, with the hardcoded list as fallback; the web row pins that fallback still drops Codex's client-side `web` namespace on Mantle and substitutes the hosted web_search tool, which folder 33 never exercised. The bedrock/ row pins the legacy in-provider Mantle route.

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-sol /v1/responses Codex 0.147 functions namespace is unwrapped to top-level tools (raw_request) - #7048

exec:
if ([401, 403, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
// 400 is deliberately NOT skipped: "collides with an existing tool namespace" is the failure signature.
pm.test('bedrock_mantle gpt-5.6-sol: explicit functions namespace is accepted - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'pre-fix reserved-namespace 400 resurfaced').to.not.include('collides with an existing tool namespace');
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('bedrock_mantle gpt-5.6-sol: functions members hoisted to top level, unprefixed - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(rrText, 'the functions namespace container reached the provider').to.not.match(/"name"\s*:\s*"functions"/);
pm.expect(rrText, 'the member must keep its bare name').to.include('"wait"');
pm.expect(rrText, 'the default namespace must never become a prefix').to.not.include('functions__wait');
